name: Amylu Organic Apple & Gouda Fully Cooked Chicken Sausage (Costco)
whyItWorks: Fully cooked skinless chicken sausages made with coarse-ground chicken breast and dried apple bits. Contains far less grease and nitrates than pork sausage links, offering gentle breakfast protein.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Warm gently in a skillet or toaster oven without charring. Gouda is aged and naturally low in lactose, but enjoy in moderate portion (1 link).
